network_observation.method: netstat -ano filtered on Obsidian pids 1240 and 11480
network_observation.external_connections: NONE observed at steady state and during reimport cycles

background_indexing.observation: event_logs reimport cycles advance without user action (ct 4994 to 4997 during observation window)

cross_vault_isolation_test.method: both vaults open simultaneously (IA_Dev_Brain and Triforce_IA_Brain); full-text search of each smart_sources store for the other vault path

controlled_embed_test.method: two probe notes written by filesystem (well above min_chars), wait 25s and 45s, then search smart_sources.ajson
controlled_embed_test.verdict: REPRODUCIBLE FAILURE: new notes are not embedded; embedding:error increments every attempt; existing index frozen

blocking_property: indexing/embedding integrity at runtime (background_behavior): the live instance errors on every new embedding and does not update the semantic index
user_action_required: repair the Smart Connections embedding pipeline in the live vault (redownload/reinstall the local embedding model cache or reinstall plugin 4.7.2 via Obsidian UI), then re-run the controlled embed test
auto_resume_condition: a probe note is found in smart_sources.ajson after a reimport cycle and embedding:error stops incrementing
